audit.whatIsWrong: Lane text attributes the spin-through chip to her W.
audit.why: The spin that ticks you while she kites is Blooming Blows (Q, 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s, 65 mana); Watch Out! Eep! (W, 14/13/12/11/10s) is a stationary area nuke. The early lane is lost to Q's stacking move speed, not to W.
audit.corrected: Early lane: Blooming Blows spins through you and stacks her move speed; that is the ability you bait.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two-item spike names R generically and misses its real cooldown.
audit.why: Lilting Lullaby is 150/130/110s — the longest cooldown in the matchup and the one that decides whether her burst lands.
audit.corrected: Two items: Lilting Lullaby (150s at rank 1) sleep into DOT burst is the kill pattern; her non-R windows are free.

audit.whatIsWrong: Swirlseed reveals stealth and Blooming Blows' edge deals true damage — neither reaches the page.
audit.why: Swirlseed (E, 12s, 700 range) rolls until it hits terrain or a target and reveals stealth, which strips Going Rogue's camouflage on a roam. Blooming Blows' edge damage is true, so armour does not answer it. Lilting Lullaby's drowsy-then-sleep interrupts a Comeuppance channel.
audit.corrected: Swirlseed rolls through brush and reveals Going Rogue camo; Blooming Blows' edge is true damage; Lilting Lullaby cuts your R channel.

edits.after: Dream-Laden Bough's DOT plus Blooming Blows (Q, 6s) chip you while its move-speed stacks build — your lone Q-and-passive-shot poke trades down because you can't pin a champ floating in and out untouched.

edits.before: Liandry's/Cosmic-Drive Lillia kites with W/E and sleeps you with R into full DOT burst — her move speed dances out of E and Q range and reclaims the sidewave from your squishy lethality frame.
edits.after: Liandry's/Cosmic-Drive Lillia kites and Lilting Lullaby (R, 110s) sleeps you into full DOT burst — her move speed dances out of E and Q range and reclaims the sidewave from your squishy lethality frame.

edits.after: At Level 1 Akshan has only Q and a single passive second-shot, while Dream-Laden Bough's DOT and Blooming Blows stack her move speed so she floats away untouched.

edits.after: Two-item Lillia kites on Q move-speed stacks and Lilting Lullaby sleeps you into DOT burst that shreds your low-armour lethality frame faster than you can channel R.

edits.before: Lillia's early game is her passive Dream-Laden DOT, her W spin-through, and her E/movement speed — she rolls in, tics you with the burn, and floats back before your Avengerang loops home. At Level 1-2 you have only Q and a single passive second-shot, so you can't punish a champ who never sits still: let Q clip her on the return as she peels off and try to land your passive's third hit for the shield before you eat free DOT. Don't chase her W spin into bad spacing — she has no shield and a short mana pool, but you also have no hard gap-closer until your E comes online, so the chip war leans her way while she can kite untouched.
edits.after: Lillia's early game is Dream-Laden Bough's DOT, Blooming Blows (Q) spinning through you, and stacking move speed — she rolls in, tics the burn, and floats back before your Avengerang loops home. At Level 1-2 you have only Q and a single passive second-shot, so you can't punish a champ who never sits still: let Q clip her on the return as she peels off and land your passive's third hit for the shield before you eat free DOT. Don't chase the spin into bad spacing — she has no shield and Q costs 65 mana, but you have no gap-closer until E, so the chip war leans her way while she kites untouched.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your one real laning window, and it's wall-dependent: Heroic Swing only hooks terrain, so if she fights near a wall you can E-swing onto her and let the second-shot passive plus Q sweet-spot out-trade her W tics — she has no way to brawl back. At 6 Comeuppance is your equalizer: it locks on and ramps with her missing health, so a stored shot when her own DOT or a sloppy W leaves her low can chunk or finish her at range, and she has no Zhonya's yet to eat it. Force the all-in on her cooldowns — bait the W spin, E off the wall, Q the sweet-spot, then channel R the second she's low. Miss the wall, though, and she just kites the swing.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your one real laning window, and it's wall-dependent: Heroic Swing only hooks terrain, so if she fights near a wall you E-swing onto her and let the second-shot passive plus Q sweet-spot out-trade her Blooming Blows tics — she has no way to brawl back. At 6 Comeuppance ramps with her missing health, so a stored shot when the DOT leaves her low can finish her at range — but Lilting Lullaby (150s at rank 1) drowsies and sleeps you mid-channel, so fire before she casts it. Bait Blooming Blows (6s), E off the wall, Q the sweet-spot, then channel R. Miss the wall and she kites the swing.
